fact: The Department of Information reports a second stakeholder consultation on the Cybersecurity Bill 2026, after a draft circulated in August 2026, with the Bill still to proceed through the next legislative stages; Cabinet split the 2024 bill into a Cybercrime Bill 2026 and a Cybersecurity Bill 2026.

The Lesotho Tribune reports the Director General of ICT saying the Cybercrime Bill and the Cybersecurity Bill, split from the Computer Crime and Cybersecurity Bill, are ready and waiting for approval by the National Assembly; the article was published 2026-08-02 and the statement is dated to that publication.

The Lesotho Times reports the Cybersecurity Bill 2026 under a two-day stakeholder consultation before it returns to Parliament, after a 2021 version was withdrawn from Parliament and the 2024 Computer Crime and Cyber Security Bill was referred to Parliament but not enacted; the article is dated by its publication date, 2026-09-24.
The MICSTI Principal Secretary said the ministry was working on the Cybersecurity Bill and had met challenges that prompted a study tour to Botswana; no enactment is stated.

The National Assembly document is the Computer Crime and Cyber Security Bill, 2024, which would commence on gazettal and be cited as the Act once enacted; the document gives no date beyond the year 2024, so the published date is used.
